title: Luxuriously Sweet Canadian Honey Pudding
description: A rich and gooey dessert featuring clear honey, perfect for a date night, this Canadian dish is made using a bain-marie and is friendly to those who prefer raw ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, whisk together the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and clear honey over medium heat until the sugar has dissolved.
In a small bowl, whisk together the large egg yolks and pure vanilla extract.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the unsalted butter until melted.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the large eggs and all-purpose flour.
Slowly pour the egg mixture into the cream mixture, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4 ramekins or small baking dishes and place in a large baking dish.
Add hot water to the large baking dish to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
